title: 600,000 WordPress Sites Affected by Arbitrary File Upload Vulnerability in Forminator Forms WordPress Plugin
content_md: On July 14th, 2026, we received a submission for an Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload vulnerability in Forminator Forms , a WordPress plugin with more than 600,000 active installations. This vulnerability makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary files, including executable PHP files, to a vulnerable site, which can lead to remote code execution and complete site compromise. The vulnerability is only exploitable on sites that have a form containing both a File Upload field and a Select field. Props to daroo who discovered and responsibly reported this vulnerability through the Wordfence Bug Bounty Program . This researcher earned a bounty of $2,048.00 for this discovery. Our mission is to secure WordPress through defense in depth, which is why we are investing in quality vulnerability research and collaborating with researchers of this caliber through our Bug Bounty Program. We are committed to making the WordPress ecosystem more secure through the detection and prevention of vulnerabilities, which is a critical element to the multi-layered approach to security.
